function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_add_custom_dashboard
function.description: This function creates a new custom dashboard with a specified configuration and adds it to the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

description.description: A brief description of the dashboard's purpose and contents.

is_public.description: A flag indicating whether the dashboard should be public or private.
